pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.3: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.5: Ariṭṭhassa kira nāma bhikkhuno gaddhabādhipubbassa evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.7: atha kho te bhikkhū yena Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.8: upasaṃkamitvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.9: saccaṃ kira te āvuso Ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.11: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.12: māvuso Ariṭṭha evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.13: anekapariyāyena āvuso Ariṭṭha antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā alañ ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.14: appassādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.15: aṭṭhikaṅkalūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.24: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.25: evam pi kho Ariṭṭho bhikkhu gaddhabādhipubbo tehi bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath' eva taṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ thāmasā parāmāsā abhinivissa voharati:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.26: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.27: yato ca kho te bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetuṃ atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.28: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā Ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gaddhabādhipubbaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.29: saccaṃ kira te Ariṭṭha evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.31: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavatā . . . antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.32: kassa nu kho nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa mayā evaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.33: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā alañ ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.34: appassādā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.44: sappasirūpamā kāmā vuttā mayā bahudukkhā bahūpāyāsā ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.45: atha ca pana tvaṃ moghapurisa attanā duggahitena amhe c' eva abbhācikkhasi attānañ ca khaṇasi bahuñ ca apuññaṃ pasavasi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.46: taṃ hi te moghapurisa bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.47: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.48: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.50: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye 'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.51: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam assa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.52: māyasmā evaṃ avaca, mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkhi, na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ, na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya;
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.53: anekapariyāyena āvuso antarāyikā dhammā antarāyikā vuttā bhagavatā alañ ca pana te paṭisevato antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.54: evañ ca pana so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tath' eva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāvatatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:1.55: yāvatatiyañ ce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, icc etaṃ kusalam.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.6: tathāhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ . . . nālaṃ antarāyāyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.10: aññehi bhikkhūhi ye passanti ye suṇanti tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.18: so bhikkhu saṃghamajjhaṃ pi ākaḍḍhitvā vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.29: itthannāmassa bhikkhuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.32: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.39: saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.40: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno samanubhāsanā tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya so tuṇh' assa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.51: samanubhaṭṭho saṃghena itthannāmo bhikkhu tassā diṭṭhiyā paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.1.52: khamati saṃghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evam etaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc68:2.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
